body: Orchestrator integration note (space-sprint-1): merging DM-188 after DM-190 failed typecheck — DM-190 made `EpicProvenance` a union (`EarlierEpicProvenance | CorrectionProvenance`) and DM-188's `correctionHolderProblem` read `provenance.sourceEpicId` directly. Fixed in the integration branch with `followUpSourceOf` (src/core/plan/corrections.ts): only same-project follow-up provenance counts; a cross-repo correction epic is not a follow-up. Typecheck, oxlint, 19 test files (481 tests) and DM-186/188/190 scripts pass after the fix.
